rachel_sdr: Hey team — Ellie from MeridianRetail flagged a POC ask: multi-tenant ingestion + streaming outputs + function/tool-calls returning structured JSON. They want a quick checklist: security questionnaire answers, a pricing ballpark for a 3-month pilot (peak 50 rps, avg 10 rps, 5M tokens/day), and an SDK sample showing streaming + function calls. Any blockers?
ellie_cust: thx! also need SSO (SAML), KMS for token encryption, and a short runbook we can hand to infra.
devendra_se: OK — high level: we can demo using Hosted API for fast setup, or Dedicated if they need isolation/SLA. For 5M tokens/day client-side estimate: hosted per-token gives ~X$/token but for pilots we typically offer a blended pilot rate — I'll draft numbers.
devendra_se: checklist for the POC: 1) sample payloads (we need one full request sample with functions + expected JSON schema), 2) SAML metadata from their IdP, 3) KMS key alias or plan for external HSM, 4) target SLA/latency SLO, 5) data residency requirement.
marta_prod: Security notes: for enterprise we usually recommend Dedicated or Private if they require customer-managed KMS / SOC2 controls. Answers to typical questionnaire items: TLS 1.3 in transit, AES-256 at rest, customer KMS via BYOK supported on Private, audit logs retained (customizable), and we have standard pen-test reports. I'll attach the short Q&A doc.
security_bot: Security questionnaire uploaded: https://redwood.internal/sq/meridian-1714567890 (access: sales+sec only) :lock: 
ben_infra: For streaming & function calls, watch the connection handshake: if they're using SSE/websocket, we recommend ephemeral creds + a 1hr token TTL for POC. Backpressure strategy: use continuous batching with client-side rate cap. If they want guaranteed latency, use Dedicated with reserved slots.
devendra_se: SDK snippet (python) we can give them for streaming + tool calling — small example that shows the event and function schema:```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="<REDACTED>")
with client.stream(model="redwood-chat-1") as s:
    s.send({"input":"Summarize orders for tenant_id=42", "functions":[{"name":"get_orders","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"tenant_id":{"type":"integer"}}}}]})
    for event in s.recv():
        if event.type == 'function_call':
            # call local service and send result back
            result = get_orders(event.args)
            s.send({"function_response": result})
        elif event.type == 'chunk':
            print(event.text, end='')
```
devendra_se: emphasize structured output by passing a validation schema and using our `structured_output` flag — we will show `200 OK` responses with a machine-parseable JSON payload.
ellie_cust: can you show how to do the handshake for websocket + short-lived creds? we need code to rotate in our infra.
ben_infra: handshake example (curl-ish):```bash
# request ephemeral token from our auth bridge
curl -X POST https://auth.meridian.example/get-ephemeral -d '{"user":"svc-demo"}' | jq -r .token
# connect
wscat -c "wss://stream.redwood.ai/v1?token=<EPHEMERAL>"
```
ben_infra: For rotation — call the ephemeral API every 45min and atomically swap in new token on reconnect. We avoid in-stream token swap to keep connections stable.
marta_prod: Pricing note for sales: for a 3-month pilot with 5M tokens/day and 50rps peaks, recommend proposing a blended pilot cap + a dedicated trial discount and an option to convert to reserved capacity. I'll provide two buckets: hosted pilot estimate and a Dedicated monthly commit estimate.
devendra_se: potential blocker: if Meridian requires on-prem processing of PII we need to plan Private deployment timeline (~6-8 weeks) — call this out in the handoff doc. Otherwise Hosted + VPC egress + BYOK covers most enterprise needs.
rachel_sdr: Ellie — we can get the SAML metadata and your KMS outline. Would you be ok with a 2-hour POC with us next Wed 9am PST? We'll demo streaming tool-calls, structured output, and a quick Q&A with Security/Product.
ellie_cust: Wed 9am PST works. Please include infra contact (I'll invite).
ops_bot: Deploy-preview for demo environment created: demo-env-1714567890 — creds will be DM'd to participants.
security_bot: Added note: we recommend running the security questionnaire appendix (section A.3) before the demo if they need SOC2 artifacts.
devendra_se: I'll draft the sample payload and a short `README.md` runbook for handshake, token rotation, and failure modes. Also adding a small test suite we can run to verify structured JSON responses.
marta_prod: I'll attach the SOC2 summary and KMS integration steps to the sales playbook.
rachel_sdr: Great — next actions: Devendra to send SDK sample + pricing ballpark by EOD today; Marta to attach security artifacts; Ben to share ephemeral token runbook; Sales to schedule calendar and collect SAML metadata.
ellie_cust: thanks all — excited to see it in action :party_parrot:
